positions.title: Professional Research Assistant
positions.description:
Duties included:
1. Scala developer on an internal version of the latis library (https://github.com/latis-data/latis). Our version ties many disparate data sources and serves the data over http.
2. Configuration developer using Ansible. I automate the deployment of our web services both internal and in the DMZ. Using Hudson/Jenkins in combination with Ansible, I automate the deployment of web servers running Glassfish, Jetty, and Tomcat, Docker containers running Single Page Web Apps as well as an entire Dockerized version of our Single Sign On service.
